title: Apollo 11 'halfway to the moon' window footage faked in Earth orbit

tellings.quote: There's also the uncovered footage that BART has that shows them saying that they're 230,000 miles out or or 30,000 halfway, right?

plain: Footage from the 1969 Apollo 11 flight, in which the crew is heard saying they are far out, about halfway to the moon, was really shot while they were still in orbit around Earth, according to a man named Bart Sibrel. Joe Rogan relays this to Michels, saying Sibrel has the uncovered footage, and also names David Percy and Neil Armstrong. If so, the view from the window was staged to make the craft look farther away than it was.
